reasoning: The requirement that the graph consists of exactly two vertex‑disjoint cliques of size 3 and that every vertex belongs to one of these cliques can cover only 6 vertices, but the graph must have 12 vertices. Hence no such graph can exist.
cot_trace: We need graph with 12 vertices, exactly two vertex-disjoint cliques of size 3, and every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, and the only edges are within these cliques. That means graph consists of two K3 components, total vertices 6. But we have 12 vertices, and every vertex must belong to one of these cliques, but cliques size 3, two cliques cover 6 vertices only. Contradiction. So UNSAT.
